task.description: Read handoffs/WF03-ISS0273-20260822/step-01-issue-fixer.json's result.summary in full -- ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis and recommendation. Produce a design (append a new addendum section, or a new small design doc under lib/letflow/design/, your call which reads more naturally as a follow-on to lib/letflow/design/iss0262-h6-floor-commit-addendum.md) for pinning @h6_floor_commit in lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex to a fixed commit sha instead of re-deriving it via git merge-base on every run. Design must specify exactly: (1) the literal sha value to pin @h6_floor_commit to (ISSUE-FIXER recommends c4a8e397 -- the parent of 184d846, the commit that merged the H6 check -- verify their reasoning about ancestor_or_equal?'s sha==floor treatment yourself before endorsing it, and state the full 40-char sha, not the short form); (2) what happens to resolve_h6_floor_commit/0's runtime git-merge-base fallback path and the BOOTSTRAP sentinel -- the design must state plainly whether that whole runtime-resolution mechanism is removed now that a real value exists (simplifying h6_floor_commit/0 back to just returning the constant), or kept as a fallback for some other reason, with a clear justification either way; (3) exactly which comment blocks (the BOOTSTRAP placeholder comment, the moduledoc H6 bullet, the design doc it points to) need updating so the source no longer describes a not-yet-resolved bootstrap state; (4) what test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs's 3 currently-failing assertions (T-NEW-AFTER-FLOOR-HARD-FAILS, F-H6-CONTENT-NEVER-READ, F-H6-FIRES-NEW per the diagnosis) need to assert once the floor is a fixed value instead of a moving one -- specifically, whether the existing fixtures/logic still work once floor is genuinely fixed, or whether the test needs a fresh throwaway post-floor fixture construction. Design artefacts only: interfaces, exact literal values, and specs -- no .ex function bodies beyond what iss0262-h6-floor-commit-addendum.md already established as the pattern to follow. State explicitly that this is a narrow, scoped fix (pin the value + remove the now-dead bootstrap branch) and not a redesign of the H6 mechanism itself.
acceptance_criteria: Exact 40-char sha to pin @h6_floor_commit to, with verified reasoning (not just copied from the diagnosis) for why that sha and not 184d846 itself
Explicit disposition of resolve_h6_floor_commit/0's runtime fallback and the BOOTSTRAP sentinel -- removed or kept, with justification
Exact comment/moduledoc locations that must be updated so no stale bootstrap-state prose remains
Clear guidance for what the 3 currently-failing tests must assert post-fix, and whether existing fixtures suffice or a new fixture is needed
No .ex implementation bodies present -- signatures/specs/literal values only
